Local* local-properties parity (#494)::Well-conditioned surface points agree
source: Same quantities on both sides: kmax and kmin of a sphere (r 5, u 0, v 0.3) and a cylinder (r 3, u 1.2, v -0.8), H of the apex cone (v 0.01), and for the plane at (1, 2) defined and umbilic. Bridge: Surface.localCurvatures(u:v:) read with a temporary print in the test helper (not committed): sphere maxCurvature -0.2 and minCurvature -0.20000000000000004, cylinder 0.0 and -0.33333333333333326, cone mean -86.60254037844388; for the plane localCurvatures is non-nil (defined true) and localCurvatureDirections is nil, which is the bridge's umbilic rejection (OCCTSurfaceLocalCurvatureDirections sets isDefined = IsCurvatureDefined() && !IsUmbilic()), so umbilic true. Kernel: GeomLProp_SLProps at Precision::Confusion() printed, in the wellConditionedSurfacesAgree section of transcript-evidence-fix.txt, kmax -0.20000000000000001 (the double -0.2) and kmin -0.20000000000000004; kmax 0 and kmin -0.33333333333333326; H -86.602540378443877; plane defined=1 umbilic=1. The bridge and kernel doubles are identical. The earlier record carried kmin -0.2 and -0.3333333333333333, which are not the measured doubles (corrected).

test_name: Local* local-properties parity (#494)::Inside the old 1e-10 window the two Surface families agree
source: Same quantity on both sides: whether curvature is defined. Bridge: Surface.localCurvatures(u: 0, v:) on the apex cone (semi-angle pi/6, radius 0) was nil at v 1e-9, 1e-8 and 1e-7 and non-nil at v 3e-7 and 1e-6; on a radius-3 sphere at v = pi/2 - delta it was nil at delta 1e-9 and 1e-8 and non-nil at 1e-7 (temporary print of the helper's local value, not committed; principalCurvatures agrees, as the test asserts). Kernel: GeomLProp_SLProps IsCurvatureDefined() at Precision::Confusion() printed defined=0 for the cone at v 1e-9, 1e-8, 1e-7 and defined=1 at 3e-7 and 1e-6; defined=0 for the sphere at delta 1e-9 and 1e-8 and defined=1 at 1e-7 (surfaceToleranceWindowAgrees section of transcript-evidence-fix.txt). Values are definedness only, so no numeric precision is at issue.

test_name: Local* local-properties parity (#494)::Genuinely degenerate surface points are undefined for both families

Kernel: GeomLProp_CLProps at Precision::Confusion() printed tangent=(-0.64421768723769102, 0.7648421872844885, 0) for the circle, curvature=0 for the line and curvature=0.61059562905594267 for the Bezier (wellConditionedCurvesAgree section of transcript-evidence-fix.txt); the same doubles. The earlier record carried the circle tangent as (-0.644218, 0.764842, 0), the six-digit rounding the first transcript printed, not a measured value (corrected).

source: Same quantity on both sides: the mean curvature H of the radius-10 cylinder's lateral face at (u, v) = (0, 0), (0.5, 1) and (1.2, 2), and of its two planar caps (0 at every one of those points). Bridge: Shape.surfaceLocalProps(u:v:).meanCurvature (equal to Face.meanCurvature(atU:v:), as the test asserts) returned -0.05, -0.05 and -0.05000000000000002 on the lateral face and 0.0 on both caps at all three points (temporary print, not committed). Kernel: GeomLProp_SLProps at Precision::Confusion() on the same unique faces printed H=-0.050000000000000003, -0.050000000000000003 and -0.050000000000000017 for the Geom_CylindricalSurface and H=0 for both Geom_Plane faces at all three points (surfaceLocalPropsAgreesWithFace section of transcript-evidence-fix.txt); the same doubles. test_name: Local* local-properties parity (#494)::Shape.surfaceLocalProps agrees with Face approaching a cone apex
source: Same quantities on both sides: whether curvature is defined at v = vApex - delta on the lateral face of the cone (radius 5 to 0, height 10), for delta 1e-8 and 1e-7 (undefined) and 5e-7, 1e-6, 2e-6 and 1e-5 (defined), and the mean curvature H at delta 1e-6. The test's v is vApex - delta with vApex = (5*5 + 10*10).squareRoot() = 11.180339887498949; H at delta 1e-6 moves by about 2e-9 relative for a 2e-15 change in v, so the kernel run uses that exact v. Bridge: Shape.surfaceLocalProps(u: 0, v:) curvatureDefined was false at delta 1e-8 and 1e-7 and true at 5e-7, 1e-6, 2e-6, 1e-5 and 1.0, and meanCurvature at delta 1e-6 (v = 11.18033888749895) was -1000000.0023899348 (temporary print, not committed). Kernel: GeomLProp_SLProps at Precision::Confusion() on the same face surface printed defined=0 at v 11.180339877498948 and 11.18033978749895, defined=1 at the other deltas, and H=-1000000.0023899348 at v=11.18033888749895 (surfaceLocalPropsAgreesNearConeApex section of transcript-evidence-fix.txt). The earlier record carried apex_minus_1e-6_H -1000000.000613578, taken from a kernel run at a v that differs from the test's by 2e-15 (the apex from -RefRadius / sin(SemiAngle)); it is not the value the test path returns (corrected).

test_name: Local* local-properties parity (#494)::A cusp's infinite curvature yields no centre of curvature, not a NaN one

data.centre: raw CentreOfCurvature: Standard_ConstructionError at spacing 0; (nan, inf, nan) at spacing 1e-14, 1e-12, 1e-11

differences: centre: the bridge returns no centre (nil) where the kernel's CentreOfCurvature at the same cusp throws Standard_ConstructionError (spacing 0) or returns the non-finite point (nan, inf, nan) as if it had computed one (spacing 1e-14, 1e-12, 1e-11). The refusal is the bridge's by design (#494); curvature is RealLast on both sides.

source: Same quantities on both sides: curvature and centre at parameter 0 of a cubic Bezier cusp (first two poles spacing apart) at spacing 0, 1e-14, 1e-12, 1e-11. Bridge: Curve3D.curvature(at: 0) returned 1.7976931348623157e+308 (RealLast, Double.greatestFiniteMagnitude) at all four spacings and both centerOfCurvature(at: 0) and localCentreOfCurvature(at: 0) returned nil at all four, as the test asserts (temporary print, not committed). Kernel: GeomLProp_CLProps at Precision::Confusion() printed curvature=1.7976931348623157e+308 (RealLast) at all four and a raw CentreOfCurvature that raises Standard_ConstructionError at spacing 0 and is (nan, inf, nan) at 1e-14, 1e-12 and 1e-11 (cuspCentreOfCurvatureIsUndefined section of transcript-evidence-fix.txt). The two differ by design: the bridge refuses a centre that is not a real point (#494).

test_name: Local* local-properties parity (#494)::No local-properties entry point returns a non-finite number

differences: all_returned_values_finite: bridge true (every value an entry point returns is finite; nil means undefined) versus kernel false (the raw GeomLProp_CLProps::CentreOfCurvature at a cusp returns (nan, inf, nan) at spacing 1e-12 and 1e-8, and raises Standard_ConstructionError at spacing 0). The filter is the bridge's by design (#494).

source: Same quantity on both sides: all_returned_values_finite, whether every number the entry points return is finite. Bridge: the test's sweep (curvature, centerOfCurvature, localCentreOfCurvature, normal, localNormal, tangentDirection and localTangent on the cusp at spacing 0, 1e-12 and 1e-8, the circle and the line at u 0, 1e-9, 0.5 and 1: 20 curve points; localCurvatures and localCurvatureDirections on the apex cone and a radius-3 sphere at v 0, 1e-9, 1e-8, 1e-7, pi/2 and 1: 12 surface points) returned 306 numbers, none non-finite, so true (temporary print of every returned value, not committed; nil is not a number, and RealLast is finite). Kernel: the raw GeomLProp_CLProps tangent, curvature, Normal and CentreOfCurvature over the same 20 curve points returned 155 numbers, 15 of them non-finite, all raw centre components at the cusp: (inf, -inf, nan) at spacing 0 u 1e-9, (nan, inf, nan) at spacing 1e-12 and 1e-8 u 0, (-inf, inf, nan) at spacing 1e-12 and 1e-8 u 1e-9 (the last section of transcript-evidence-fix.txt); 15 further calls raised instead of returning, so false. The bridge's guard is what makes the two differ (#494). The kernel sweep covers the curve entry points only, since the non-finite values are curve centres; the raw surface accessors raise where curvature is undefined.
